title: Site Classes A through D.
officialText:
For Site Class A, B, C and D, transverse confinement reinforcement shall be
provided in the element in accordance with Sections 21.6.4.2, through 21.6.4.4 of ACI 318 within three times the least
element dimension of the bottom of the pile cap. A transverse spiral reinforcement ratio of not less than one -h alf of
that required in Section 21.6.4.4(a) of ACI 318 shall be permitted.
